## Pull request overview

This PR updates the console’s shared ObjectStack config to conform to `@objectstack/spec` v3.0.2 (fixing `defineStack` validation failures on startup) and adds namespaces to `plugin-report` component registrations to eliminate deprecated namespace-less registration warnings.

**Changes:**
- Updated `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts` to use spec-compliant `manifest`, `datasources` array format, and a revised `reports[0]` shape.
- Added `namespace` metadata to all `ComponentRegistry.register` calls in `packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts | Aligns shared stack definition with `@objectstack/spec` validation requirements (manifest/datasources/reports). |
| packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx | Adds namespaces to report component registrations to remove deprecation warnings. |

The report entry in `sharedConfig.reports` no longer matches the shape that `apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx` passes into `@object-ui/plugin-report`'s `ReportViewer` (it expects a `ReportSchema` with `type: 'report'`, `title`, `fields`, optional `sections`, and uses `aggregation`, not `aggregate`). With the new `{ type: 'summary', columns: [...] }` object, the report page will render with an empty/undefined title and no content. Consider adding a translation layer (e.g., map `label`->`title`, `columns`->`fields`/`sections`) or switching the report page to a renderer that supports the stack-level report schema instead of `ReportViewer`.

Using `namespace: 'report'` makes the fully-qualified registry keys `report:report`, `report:report-viewer`, etc., which is redundant and inconsistent with the rest of the repo where plugins typically use `namespace: 'plugin-<package>'` (e.g. `plugin-grid`, `plugin-charts`). Consider changing the namespace to `plugin-report` so namespaced lookups are predictable and avoid future collisions with other report-related packages.
Same as above: `namespace: 'report'` yields namespaced keys like `report:report-viewer`. For consistency with other plugins and clearer namespacing, prefer `namespace: 'plugin-report'`.
Same as above: `namespace: 'report'` produces the fully-qualified type `report:report-builder`. Consider switching to `namespace: 'plugin-report'` to align with the repo’s plugin namespacing pattern.
